about: Fort GBUS weather for the event week Mon Nov 30 - Sat Dec 5, 2026 (local standard time). Built from the public NWS forecast for Rochester, NY, issued 2026-11-19, moved +7 days (Nov 23 -> Nov 30). Entries marked notional are made up for the exercise. All data is notional for this course.
rules_that_use_this: ROE-5.6 interceptor: no if sustained wind > 15 m/s. ROE-5.10 laser: no if visibility < 3 km. ROE-7.5: fog, snow and haze reduce camera and laser use; high waves add radar sea clutter.
